note: std-google-meet over one keyed std-http-client trait: the user access token is a refresh_token grant (credential-connect) the host credential store mints and renews, carried by the MeetHttp credential, never by an event; every call is a row of MeetCall under its own key; each step (list pages, transcripts, entries pages, one display name per distinct participant) retries under keyed std-retry (4 attempts, 100 x 5^(n-1) ms capped at 1500) and the next step starts when std-retry completes the previous run; a not-held token mints once and sends again, a second not-held answer fails NOT_CONFIGURED. Self-handled internal events (declared -> internal) are consumed by the trait and not listed.
